fields.role: The job title or function of the personnel.
fields.operational_phase: The current stage of plant operation.
fields.authorization: The level of access or permission granted.
fields.parameter: The name of the operational parameter being monitored.
fields.target: The desired or ideal value for a parameter.
fields.condition: The specific alert or trip state that triggers a rule.
fields.threshold: The numeric value that defines a limit or trigger point.
fields.ro_feed_stream: The identifier for the reverse osmosis feed stream.
fields.parameter_tag: The unique instrument or sensor tag identifier.
fields.measurement: The type of physical property being measured.
fields.metric_unit: The unit of measure for the value.
fields.min_bound: The lower allowable limit of a range.
fields.max_bound: The upper allowable limit of a range.
fields.required_correction: The action to be taken to correct a parameter deviation.
fields.time_allowance: The duration permitted to perform a correction.
fields.high_pressure_intake_pump: Requirements or constraints for the high pressure intake pump.
fields.anti_scalant_dosing_pump: Requirements or constraints for the anti scalant dosing pump.
fields.permeate_bypass_valve: Requirements or constraints for the permeate bypass valve.
fields.brine_reject_flow: Requirements or constraints for the brine reject flow.
fields.main_feed_breaker: Requirements or constraints for the main feed breaker.
fields.permeate_conductivity: Requirements or constraints for permeate conductivity.
fields.required_ppe: The personal protective equipment required for a task.
fields.activity: The specific task or operation being performed.
fields.action: The required response or action to be taken.
fields.time_limit: The deadline or timeframe for completing an action.
fields.item: The object or material being handled.
fields.requirement: The specific instruction or mandate for a process.
fields.consequence: The result or outcome of a specific condition.
fields.water_quality_data: Requirements regarding the storage of water quality data.

categories.AccessRequirement: Requirements regarding personnel access and authorization.
categories.OperationalLimit: Limits related to plant operation parameters.
categories.WaterQualityLimit: Limits related to water quality parameters.
categories.StartupRequirement: Requirements that must be met during plant startup.
categories.RampUpLimit: Constraints on the rate of increasing operational load.
categories.SpillResponse: Procedures for responding to chemical spills.
categories.DisposalProcedure: Instructions for the disposal of materials.
categories.DataRetentionRequirement: Rules for the archiving of operational data.
